title: Pen Fight
description: The desk game, with real physics. Two pens on a gold-inlaid table: flick yours to shove your rival's over the edge. Where you touch the pen is the whole game — catch it at the tip and it spins, catch it at the balance point and it drives straight. Friction is integrated along the pen so a sliding, spinning pen dies out of both at once, and a rigid pen hangs flat over the lip until its centre of mass crosses, then it goes. One flick almost never ends it; you walk them back over several exchanges and finish from close range.
